page.layout: One printed page, 328, with the running head "NOTÆ." at the top. One text block of Latin, with Arabic and Greek inline, set inside a rule. Marginal notes in the left margin, beside the first paragraph of the block.

main_text.p: *in [illegible, ~6 letters] Saracen Mayedah.illa quæ juberet, alacri animo, tanquam monente Deo, pergere, sin illa quæ vetaret, desistere, quòd si ἀγεσμάτῳ[?] illa, reponere, donec prodiret, quæ vel jussu præirer, vel interdicto occurreret. Hæc videre est apud *Ebnol Athir & AlZamachsharium, & Al-Bidavvium ad cap. 5tum Alcorani, ubi morem istum ut commentum plane Diabolicum retineri vetat his verbis,
حرمت عليكم الميتة والدم ولحم الخنزير
وما اهل لغير الله به والمنخنقة والموقوذة والمتردية والنطيحة وما اكل السبع الا ما ذكيتم وما ذبح على النصب وان تستقسموا بالازلام

Prohibita sunt vobis morticinium, & sanguis, & caro porcina & super quod alius quam Dei nomen invocatum est, & suffocatum, & quod ictu, & quod lapsu mortuum est, & cornu ab alio petitum, & quod comederint fera, nisi quod ipsi jugulaveritis, & quod super lapidibus, cum in finem circa Caabam fixis, immolatum est, & ut divinatione per sortes utamini. Et rursus eodem cap.
يا ايها الذين امنوا انما الخمر والميسر والانصاب والازلام رجس من عمل الشيطان فاجتنبوه لعلكم تفلحون

vos qui creditis, vinum & AlMaiser, & statua, & Al-Azlam, abominatio sunt ex operibus Diaboli, quam fugite ut prosperè agatis. Eadem dum narrant AlMotarrezi, & Author libri AlMostatraf, tertiæ istius sagittæ, cui nihil inscriptum, non meminerunt; ut nec Authores lib. [illegible, ~5 letters] & [illegible, ~5 letters] qui adire solitos aiunt eos qui hujusmodi fortes consulere vellent, * ædituum Idololatricum aliquem, qui hâc formulâ ipsis

page.notes: Arabic marginal note at left (beside "Ebnol Athir") is only partly legible; its Arabic words are marked illegible. Greek word after "quòd si" is doubtful. Arabic words in the inline quotation after "Authores lib." are illegible. The Arabic verse lines are transcribed as read and may contain small errors. "Bidavvium" is printed as shown on the scan. Lines of the text continue onto the next page at "ipsis". The page has no catchword or signature.
